properties.description:
Detects potential abuse of LOLBAS techniques (e.g., WerFaultSecure.exe, rundll32.exe, comsvcs.dll) associated with EDR-Freeze attacks. These attacks suspend EDR or AV processes by exploiting Windows Error Reporting to create a race condition, leaving the system unmonitored.

The rule triggers when a known LOLBAS executable is run and the device stops reporting telemetry, with no legitimate shutdown or logoff activity recorded, suggesting the endpoint security agent may have been suspended.
properties.query:
// === Time Configuration ===
let LookbackWindow = 5m;         // Time window for detecting suspicious executions and last seen
let ShutdownLookback = 2h;       // Time window for checking legitimate shutdown/logoff events
// === List of known LOLBAS or EDR-freeze related binaries ===
let SuspiciousBins = datatable(FileName:string)
[
    "WerFaultSecure.exe",
    "WerFault.exe",
    "rundll32.exe",
    "comsvcs.dll",
    "msiexec.exe",
    "regsvr32.exe",
    "mshta.exe",
    "powershell.exe",
    "certutil.exe",
    "wmic.exe"
];
// === Find suspicious executions within the lookback window ===
let SuspiciousExec = DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackWindow)
| where FileName in (SuspiciousBins)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| project DeviceId, DeviceName, SuspiciousTime = TimeGenerated;
// === Find last seen activity within the same window ===
let LastSeen = DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackWindow)
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceId;
// === Check for shutdown or logoff events over a wider lookback ===
let ShutdownEvents = DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(ShutdownLookback)
| where ActionType in~ ("shutdownInitiated", "userInitiatedLogOff", "logoff", "userLoggedOff")
| summarize ShutdownTime = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceId;
// === Correlate suspicious execution with device last seen and shutdown activity ===
SuspiciousExec
| join kind=inner LastSeen on DeviceId
| join kind=leftouter ShutdownEvents on DeviceId
| extend TimeSinceLastSeen = now() - LastSeen
| where LastSeen < SuspiciousTime
| where isnull(ShutdownTime) or ShutdownTime < SuspiciousTime
| project DeviceName, DeviceId, SuspiciousTime, LastSeen, TimeSinceLastSeen, ShutdownTime
| sort by TimeSinceLastSeen desc
